mil3.3.11:2.2: Yathā mahārāja kocid-eva puriso visaṃ abhisankharitvā attanā ca piveyya pare ca pāyeyya, so attanā pi dukkhito bhaveyya, pare pi dukkhitā bhaveyyuṃ,
mil3.3.11:2.3: evam-eva kho mahārāja idh' ekacco puggalo akusalaṃ kammaṃ cetanāya cetayitvā kāyassa bhedā param-maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ uppajjeyya,
mil3.3.11:2.4: ye pi tassa anusikkhanti te pi kāyassa bhedā param-maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ uppajjanti.
mil3.3.11:3.1: Yathā vā pana mahārāja kocid-eva puriso sappi-navanīta-tela-madhu-phāṇitaṃ ekajjhaṃ abhisankharitvā attanā ca piveyya pare ca pāyeyya, so attanā pi sukhito bhaveyya, pare pi sukhitā bhaveyyuṃ,
mil3.3.11:3.2: evam-eva kho mahārāja idh' ekacco puggalo kusalaṃ kammaṃ cetanāya cetayitvā kāyassa bhedā param-maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ uppajjati,
mil3.3.11:3.3: ye pi tassa anusikkhanti te pi kāyassa bhedā param-maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ uppajjanti.
mil3.3.11:3.4: Evaṃ kho mahārāja cetayitalakkhaṇā cetanā abhisankharaṇalakkhaṇā cāti. -
